summary: Iteration 31 testing (Leadership/Gallery/Sessions). Backend: 29/29 pytest cases passed covering leader CRUD + validations (name/group/email/photo/linkedin normalization), public visibility+order, CSRF enforcement, reorder, gallery edit/hide/reorder/invalid-tag, session date/time/end-after-start validation, create session, program embed, calendar entries (kind=session), signup required-when-sessions-exist, success with session, fills-up->full rejection, delete-blocked-with-signups. Frontend: Public /leadership shows cards, modal opens with name/role/full bio, next/prev navigation works, Escape closes, mobile viewport (390x844) renders modal as bottom sheet (y=759/h=444). Admin leaders UI (add -> row -> delete) works. Admin gallery UI has all expected inputs. Admin sessions UI creates and deletes sessions. Public /sessions calendar+list render, click opens session-detail-modal with correct title and session-cta linking to /initiatives/<slug>?session=<id>#join, and signup-session-select is correctly preselected on the program page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >9500 lines — strongly recommend splitting (/leaders, /gallery, /sessions could be routers) for maintainability.

leader photo_url regex only enforces https for external URLs but admin_leader_update uses the same _clean_leader (OK). Consider also allowing data: URIs if admins paste base64 avatars (currently rejected).
_fmt_time uses strftime('%-I:%M %p') which is Linux-only (works here, but non-portable).
No pagination on /api/admin/leaders or /api/admin/gallery (currently capped at 200/1000) — fine for MVP.
test_credentials: Admin via /app/backend/tests/qa_session.py up (cookie session_token=qa_tok_123). State-changing requests require X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 QA leaders and 1 QA session during tests; all were deleted. qa_session.py down executed. DB counts of residual QA data: 0 leaders / 0 sessions / 0 submissions / 0 QA gallery media.
